# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at medium effort, 5.5× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 53.5 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.1× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 74.5 %, cost 305× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 281 sources · 871 benchmarks · 5319 measurements. Updated 2026-10-08. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.2× to 2.7× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 1.2 to 5.0 points lower on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (69.7 %, cost 378×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (69.8 %, cost 54×): 7.0× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 69.7 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 2.2× to 6.9× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 3.0 points lower and 7.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (69.7 %, cost 378×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (70.5 %, cost 58×): 6.5× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.7 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 69.7 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 20× to 98× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 6.3 to 14.1 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (69.7 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.5 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.5 %, cost 19×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (62.2 %, cost 98×): 5.3× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.8× to 3.1× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.8 to 11.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 72.7 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.7 %, cost 171×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is xHigh (73.4 %, cost 123×): 1.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 14× to 37× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 11.0 to 16.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.5 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.5 %, cost 19×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (63.3 %, cost 37×): 2.0× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 6.3× to 15× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 5.0 to 10.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.7 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.5 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.5 %, cost 19×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (65.3 %, cost 27×): 1.5× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.8× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 1.3 to 3.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (69.7 %): Fable 5's best is max at 67.8 %. To match Fable 5 at max (67.8 %, cost 385×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is xHigh (68.8 %, cost 274×): 1.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.4× what Opus 5 costs and scores 3.5 to 6.5 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Opus 5's best is max at 68.0 %. To match Opus 5 at max (68.0 %, cost 216×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (69.8 %, cost 54×): 4.0× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.4× to 1.1× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 10.0 to 15.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.7 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 56.9 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (56.9 %, cost 158×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (58.5 %, cost 17×): 9.1× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.
